timeline.evidenceText: They returned to Joshua, and said to him, “Don’t let all the people go up, but let about two or three thousand men go up and strike Ai. Don’t make all the people to toil there, for there are only a few of them.”
I gave you a land on which you had not labored, and cities which you didn’t build, and you live in them. You eat of vineyards and olive groves which you didn’t plant.’
He arose and struck the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand froze to the sword; and Yahweh worked a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to take plunder.
I will be condemned.
My eye wastes away because of grief.
Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head.
Don’t weary yourself to be rich.
The labor of fools wearies every one of them; for he doesn’t know how to go to the city.
Haven’t you known?
Even the youths faint and get weary,
but those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength.
Yet you have not called on me, Jacob;
You have not brought me any of your sheep for burnt offerings,
You have bought me no sweet cane with money,
“Stand now with your enchantments
The things that you labored in will be like this:
But I said, “I have labored in vain.
You were wearied with the length of your ways;
Yahweh has sworn by his right hand,
They will not labor in vain
